doc: Exit criterion perf, hub half: 20 mock agents stream at once (25 chunks and 25 tool calls each, about 5 s) with an editor subscribed to every event. Budgets, checked in the row: the hub's CPU over the streaming window (utime + stime from /proc, 100 ticks a second) stays under 40 percent of one core, and its resident set under 400 MB. --perf records the ping round trips taken while the agents stream (the keystroke-latency proxy: the editor's p95 must stay under 16 ms, judged on the desktop timing lane; the editor-mirror redraw half is the UI test command in docs/develop/runtime.md). The hub coalesces a session's events to one agent and agent-entries pair per 50 ms, which bounds the editor's redraws at 20 a second per session. Linux only (/proc).
